# uptimeify_im_team_override (Resource)

An override (vacation, swap) owned by an Incident Management team, optionally on one of its schedules. Import with `<team_id>/<override_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bob takes over for a release night, for the whole team.
resource "uptimeify_im_team_override" "release" {
  team_id   = uptimeify_im_team.platform.id
  user_id   = uptimeify_im_team_member.bob.user_id
  type      = "online"
  starts_at = "2030-09-01T18:00:00+02:00"
  ends_at   = "2030-09-02T06:00:00+02:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) End, after `starts_at`. RFC3339 timestamp. The API answers in UTC with milliseconds, another spelling of the same instant is kept as written.
- `starts_at` (String) Start. RFC3339 timestamp. The API answers in UTC with milliseconds, another spelling of the same instant is kept as written.
- `team_id` (Number)
- `type` (String) `online` (user takes the shift) or `offline` (user is away).
- `user_id` (String) User going online or offline; an admin, editor or responder of the organization.

### Optional

- `apply_scope` (String) `this_team` (default) or `all_teams`.
- `covered_by_user_ids` (Set of String) `offline` only: who covers (at most 200). Empty = a gap that auto fill-up backstops.
- `escalation_tier_order` (Number) Only this tier position; unset = all tiers.
- `schedule_id` (Number) A schedule of this team; unset = team-level override.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) `<team_id>/<override_id>`.
- `override_id` (Number) Numeric override id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <team_id>/<override_id>
terraform import uptimeify_im_team_override.release 12/91
```
